Surrounded by the rulers of the earth, the east, 
the west, the north and the south, the kings of aryan and 
non-aryan descent and those from the forests and the hills, 
King Dasaratha looked like Iudra in the midst of the gods. 
He beheld his son Shri Ramachaudra, handsome, valorous, 
of mighty length of arm, fearless, walking like au intoxicated

Seeing the prince standing respectfully at his side, the king

As a man adorned with many ornaments is overjoyed with

brief.summary_1line: Citizens praise Rama’s virtues, Dasaratha resolves to crown him regent, and preparations for the coronation begin under the guidance of sages and ministers.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the royal court, King Dasaratha joyfully announces Rama’s coronation as citizens and sages stand with folded hands in approval.
Sage Vasistha directs ministers to arrange gold vessels, white garlands, elephants, banners, and incense for the grand coronation ceremony.
Rama enters the palace like a majestic elephant, bows at his father’s feet, and is seated on a jewel-studded golden throne before the gathered kings.
